dispositions.fact: NADPH/NADH, Mg, homodimer and exact reaction
dispositions.disposition: Similarity to Salmonella retained; native NADPH reduction selected. No NADH exclusion or direct K-12 purified enzyme claim.

dispositions.disposition: Lineage defects and repaired strains preserved. The record does not imply that all K-12 strains display O-antigen.

dispositions.fact: VW187 O7 rfbBDAC extracts and K-12 rff homolog assays
dispositions.disposition: Donor and host distinguished. Heterologous expression does not prove these are K-12 Rml proteins; 1995 rfbC/D terminology differs from current RmlC/D accession mapping.
E. coli source and P37744 structural cross-reference independently verified; full paper unavailable, so cofactors are attributed specifically to reviewed experimental UniProt annotation.

dispositions.fact: Exact process identity and endpoint stereochemistry
dispositions.disposition: Non-obsolete exact GO process has native MetaCyc xref in pinned ontology. Endpoint canonical ChEBI label is dTDP-6-deoxy-beta-L-mannose(2-), with dTDP-beta-L-rhamnose synonym; not free L-rhamnose.

dispositions.fact: Other species, UDP/GDP-rhamnose routes, transport and downstream antigen incorporation
dispositions.disposition: Outside the four-step K-12 nucleotide-sugar boundary; no enzyme edges transferred from those contexts.
